responses:
We have city-specific tours across India! Here are some of our top destinations:

🚩 RAJASTHAN: Jaipur, Udaipur
🌴 KERALA: Munnar, Alleppey
🏔️ HILL STATIONS: Manali, Shimla, Tawang
🌊 COASTAL: Panaji (Goa), Visakhapatnam
✨ SPIRITUAL: Tirupati, Amritsar, Bodh Gaya
🌃 CITIES: Mumbai, Bangalore, Ahmedabad

Ask me about any city for details!

✨ TIRUPATI SPIRITUAL TOUR
- State: Andhra Pradesh
- Price: ₹9,000
- Type: Heritage, Popular
- Highlights: Venkateswara Temple, Silathoranam, Kapila Theertham
- Description: Famous temple city and spiritual destination.

🌊 VISAKHAPATNAM COASTAL ESCAPE
- State: Andhra Pradesh
- Price: ₹12,000
- Type: Nature
- Highlights: RK Beach, Rushikonda Beach, Submarine Museum
- Description: Beautiful coastal city with beaches and hills.

🏔️ TAWANG MONASTERY TRAIL
- State: Arunachal Pradesh
- Price: ₹18,000
- Type: Heritage, Nature
- Highlights: Tawang Monastery, Sela Pass, Madhuri Lake
- Description: Scenic monastery and mountain landscapes.

🦏 KAZIRANGA WILDLIFE SAFARI
- State: Assam
- Price: ₹14,000
- Type: Nature
- Highlights: Rhino Safari, Elephant Ride, Orchid Park
- Description: National park famous for one-horned rhinoceros.

⛩️ GUWAHATI TEMPLE TOUR
- State: Assam
- Price: ₹11,000
- Type: Heritage
- Highlights: Kamakhya Temple, Brahmaputra River Cruise, Umananda Island
- Description: Gateway to Northeast India with temples.

🧘 BODH GAYA PILGRIMAGE
- State: Bihar
- Price: ₹8,000
- Type: Heritage
- Highlights: Mahabodhi Temple, Bodhi Tree, Great Buddha Statue
- Description: Sacred Buddhist pilgrimage site.

🏖️ PANAJI BEACH PARADISE
- State: Goa
- Price: ₹16,000
- Type: Nature, Popular
- Highlights: Baga Beach, Old Goa Churches, Mandovi River Cruise
- Description: Portuguese heritage and beach paradise.

🧵 AHMEDABAD HERITAGE TOUR
- State: Gujarat
- Price: ₹11,000
- Type: Heritage
- Highlights: Sabarmati Ashram, Adalaj Stepwell, Kankaria Lake
- Description: Heritage city with rich cultural history.

⛷️ MANALI ADVENTURE ESCAPE
- State: Himachal Pradesh
- Price: ₹15,000
- Type: Nature, Popular
- Highlights: Solang Valley, Rohtang Pass, Hadimba Temple
- Description: Adventure sports and mountain beauty.

🏠 SHIMLA QUEEN OF HILLS
- State: Himachal Pradesh
- Price: ₹13,000
- Type: Nature
- Highlights: The Ridge, Mall Road, Kufri
- Description: Queen of Hills with colonial charm.

🌳 BANGALORE GARDEN CITY
- State: Karnataka
- Price: ₹12,000
- Type: Popular
- Highlights: Lalbagh Botanical Garden, Bangalore Palace, Bannerghatta Park
- Description: Tech hub with gardens and nightlife.

🏰 MYSORE ROYAL HERITAGE
- State: Karnataka
- Price: ₹10,000
- Type: Heritage
- Highlights: Mysore Palace, Brindavan Gardens, Chamundi Hills
- Description: Royal heritage and cultural richness.

🍃 MUNNAR TEA GARDENS
- State: Kerala
- Price: ₹12,000
- Type: Nature, Popular
- Highlights: Tea Museums, Eravikulam National Park, Mattupetty Dam
- Description: Beautiful hill station with tea plantations.

🛶 ALLEPPEY BACKWATERS
- State: Kerala
- Price: ₹15,000
- Type: Nature
- Highlights: Houseboat Stay, Alappuzha Beach, Vembanad Lake
- Description: Famous for its backwaters and houseboats.

🌃 MUMBAI FINANCIAL CAPITAL
- State: Maharashtra
- Price: ₹15,000
- Type: Popular
- Highlights: Gateway of India, Marine Drive, Elephanta Caves
- Description: Financial capital with diverse culture.

✨ AMRITSAR GOLDEN TEMPLE
- State: Punjab
- Price: ₹10,000
- Type: Heritage, Popular
- Highlights: Golden Temple, Wagah Border Ceremony, Jallianwala Bagh
- Description: Home to the Golden Temple.

🚩 JAIPUR PINK CITY
- State: Rajasthan
- Price: ₹14,000
- Type: Popular, Heritage
- Highlights: Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, Chokhi Dhani
- Description: The Pink City.

⛵ UDAIPUR CITY OF LAKES
- State: Rajasthan
- Price: ₹16,000
- Type: Heritage
- Highlights: Lake Pichola, City Palace, Jag Mandir
- Description: The City of Lakes.
